opportunities.description: Sales opportunities from the public Maven Analytics CRM sample (fictional company MavenTech), dates shifted to FY27.

fields.amount: Deal value in USD. Closed deals use the recorded close value; open deals have none in the source, so the product's list price is used as an estimate (amount_is_estimate = true).
fields.stage: Sales stage from the source: Prospecting, Engaging, Won, Lost.
fields.close_date: Actual close date for Won/Lost. For open deals, an estimate: engage date + 57 days (median sales cycle), rolled forward if already past.
fields.region_id: Regional office of the sales rep who owns the deal (central, east or west).
fields.owner_user_id: Sales rep (sales agent in the source) who owns the deal.
fields.account_id: Customer account. Empty for many open deals in the source.

quotas.description: Synthetic sales quotas per sales rep and fiscal quarter (the CRM sample has no quota data): 1.2x the rep's average quarterly won revenue over the last year.

fields.amount: Quota in USD for the period.
fields.period: Fiscal quarter label, for example FY27-Q1.
fields.user_id: Sales rep the quota belongs to.

accounts.description: Customer accounts from the CRM sample.

fields.revenue_musd: Annual revenue in millions of USD.

account_team.description: Account-access mapping: reps with deals on the account and the technical seller supporting their team.
